title: neon genesis evangelion
body:
notes

**episode 1**

shinji seems to have been living a mostly pointless existence until the start of the show (similar to denji from chainsaw man), but is all of a sudden swept up by his father working for a secret international agency to save the world. his father doesnt care for his child at all and only sees shinji as an asset.

rei seems to be the "pro" that will probably end up teaching shinji how to grow? she appeared at the start of the show for one shot which was weird, but im pretty sure this show has something to do with time so im sure that will all make sense later

there are a lot of shots of the mech (01) that make it look like a regular sized human, makes me think its going to stand in as a metaphor for what shinji wants to be but cant. shinji repeats to himself "dont run away" when holding rei, (who also just had some sort of serious injury?) meaning hes prone to run from conflict and has to use every fiber in him to not do so when in a situation this dire

they call the big monster an angel, which seems like weird phrasing. maybe in this universe they call it that because they believe it was sent by god to punish them for their sins? id personally call that a devil though. weird idk. it also isnt explained where it comes from, so i guess thats something i need to look out for as well

**episode 2**

the angels (plural) seem to have attacked earth already, 15 years ago which would be the year 2000 in universe

removing the can that was blocking shinjis nudity to reveal another can behind it is one of the funniest visual gags ive ever seen

misato reminds me a lot of sasha from attack on titan, i like her

i assume we are watching this mainly through shinjis POV which means hes a pervert but honestly fair, idek how old he is yet so it might be important to the story

wait, shinji won the fight against the angel??? wtf? or am i misunderstanding. im just realizing i didnt question how he got fucked up so bad and had 0 injuries. thats definitely important LOL

misato also says shes using shinji as a means to an end

shinji has said "a ceiling i havent seen before" twice now

post episode:

wtf???? wtf is an eva? have they created a new form of being? it connects to shinji somehow? it can act of its own will? its a fleshy real creature inside of a metal armor suit?

theres a shot of shinjis eye and the eva's eye up close matched together. theres definitely some soul link sorta thing happening here

when there was an explosion (i think it was the angels doing)? it looked like a massive green cross. maybe that's where they get their name from

**episode 3**

"he does whatever hes told, thats how he makes his life easier"

shinji does NOT want this job lmfao

"shinji might be the sort of person who cant make friends easily"
he just like me fr

theres a shot of rei in the corner looking out the window during this conversation, seems that shes similar. i hope they get along. i dont know anything about her but i like her a lot

shinji why the fuckw ould you admit to being the pilot oh my god dude

also seems that angels came from a meteor that hit antarctica, wiping out half the population in the process

"father isnt here to watch, so why am i doing this again?"

im noticing a lot of very strongly colored scenes so ill start writing them down when i notice to see if theres any noticable pattern

fully red scene when shinji was charging at the angel and using all his might to win

immediately after, when the eva runs out of power, fully blue. silence.

now the kid who punched shinji is calling him to apologize and the entire room is bright green

i remember when there was that secret UN meeting with the teleporters/holograms each chair had a color code as well, i wonder what color shinjis dad was

also on colors, rei is very blue, and we've only seen her in this depressed, quiet state. guess thats more evidence. im pretty sure theres a character who is red but we havent met her yet. shes pretty iconic. knowing that theres a red and a blue mech pilot, i wonder if misato is the average of the both, mixing red and blue for purple.

post episode

so we genuinely have no clue if shinji is okay, he didnt pick up the phone, but considering the kids who he saved were okay, hes probably just in the UN base

during the fight, when hes down, he repeats the same "dont run away" line, i wonder if he ran away from something in his past that led to a bad outcome

he also is completely helpless at the start of the fight, noting that his dad isnt watching so why is he even trying. but when he sees his classmates he gets a bit of a second wind. hes incredibly selfless, almost to his own detriment. i really hope he finds himself and learns how to act for himself

**episode 4**

shinji has been skipping school today, misato is unsure if theres an end in sight

aw he ran away :( the one thing hes been telling himself not to do

he sees a couple in front of him making out, hes super lonely :( why would you run man you had it going

theres a scene where shinji is walking alone, the entire shot is flooded in this deep red, he sees the city spinning and hears monsterous groans/howls, then runs away again. maybe his conscious cant handle the damage the eva caused t o the city

HES 14!! WTF SO YOUNG

also looks like hes having suicidal ideation

rei is 14 too which means they HAVE to fall in love come on guys

"piloting an eva with that attitude will get you killed"
"thats okay, i dont care"

kid from his class (forget name) plays out a scenario in a field where his lieutenant is dying and is ordering him to go on without him, kid wants to save him. maybe foreshadowing between shinji and misato?

theres some weird symbolism im not getting here with the retractable city. if the beasts are angels, and the nerv lab is under the city, does that make the humans/nerv demons/hell? i dont think the city retracting would be so visibly obvious if it werent to show how deep and underground nerv is, otherwise it would be easy to forget

brooo right after i typed that theres a logo for nerv that says "God's in his heaven..." and the rest is purposely being left out of frame fuckkk let me read it
![[Pasted image 20260720150407.png]]


what a great shot omg i love this show

the only reason shinji is willing to pilot the eva is because he isnt willing to subject others to it. he genuinely values himself less than every other person on the planet

misato tells shinji angrily, only pilot the mech if YOU want to
she leaves, and shinjis face is coated in red light again

shinjis father refers to a third and fourth "children", which i assume is pilots
rei = 1, shiji = 2, red hair girl that we havent met yet = 3, ???? = 4

shinji retires from nerv, surprisingly they allow him, thats definitely an expectation subversion

actually, the way they speak makes it seem like the fourth pilot is the red hair girl, and shinji/rei are 2/3. is there a dead, first pilot?

so many shots of telephone poles in this show, metaphor for interconnectedness of everyone? maybe its trying to say that not taking care of yourself is actually selfish, as everyone is you and you are everyone else.

"if you dont stick around, we'll all probably have to leave town eventually. But we cant force you to stay" shinjis expression visibly goes from depressed/vacant to surprised and conflicted

"im dishonest and a coward. im a sneak and a weakling" -shinji to school friends 

misatos car is so fucking sick

post episode:

ooooh ok we have some hope in shinji now. he pondered at the train station very heavily. he heard what his friends said about him leaving which really readjusted his mindset. him running back to tell them that hes a coward was the first inkling of his regret. he still thought he was going to leave at that time, but in the time it took for his train to arrive his mind seems to have changed. he says "im home" to misato after that super powerful scene of them just staring at each other. i love the use of cicadas as background noise in this show, it feels soooo real. man i just love how cicadas sound honestly LOL

so. shinjis back to pilot 01, rei is recovering from her injuries, she can pilot 00. and theyre looking for another pilot that they cant find. now im left with the question, why does it matter? didnt shinji already defeat both of the angels? or do they expect more to come 

if so, does that mean theres some angel "hive" somewhere?

**episode 5**

ok i think the start of the episode was how rei got injured, i want to say it feels like shinjis dad cares about her as more than an operator, but i could be wrong

"the first subject chosen as a result of marduk institute research findings"
"The First Children"

that fucks up my theory from last episode, rei is 1, shinji is 2, 3 is red girl? 4 is ???

its also notable that they found rei through research, whats special about her? why do they refer to her as Children plural? is it because of some soul-related thing that allows her to pilot the evas? but the evas also have a mind of their own in a way, why are they aggressive? are they angels from the first invasion turned weapons of humanity?

in the wreckage of her eva theres a cross, makes my theory above stronger

the theory as to why she couldnt operate it properly is because of unwell mental state, her past was wiped. maybe shes been through something traumatic too

"Angels are composed of matter that displays the properties of both particles and waves just like light" ohhhh shit this is gonna be right up my alley

they arent sure how angels are "powered", so theyre robotic then?

it also has a "waveform fingerprint" that is a 99.89% match to human dna? my soul theory is getting stronger

the first time we've seen positive emotion from rei is when she was talking to shinji's dad. shinjis dad was tearing up during the conversation even though it didnt seem like there would be any reason for that to happen. shinji notices and seems took aback, jealous? crushing? something else? either way i do think that shinjis dad cares about her more than just as a tool

yayyy shinji has a crush on rei

shinji puts on his dads glasses (which rei has kept as a keepsake, so she cares about him too), and rei took them off. that feels super relevant. the son of the one person we've seen her be positive around. hmmmmm

i aspire to be as a chill as rei

post episode:

wow that episode felt fast as fuck, how could shinji POSSIBLY get out of this? maybe this is the intro to red hair girl? maybe rei steps up to save him? idk man

when rei's eva was deactivating there were some trippy ass visuals, i bet piloting an eva fucks with your conscious in some way

**episode 6**

its odd how compassionate/understanding nerv is, youd expect a company like this in a situation like this to have absolutely 0 regards for shinjis feelings

theyre so willing to let him go it even surprises shinji, maybe thats to show that nerv isnt an evil company as one would expect? itd be a lot easier to root against them if they were forcing shinji into a position he didnt want to be in, the only person who can make him do the things he needs to do is him

how are both evas being piloted? red hair girl? or he had a change of heart

omg yay i knew it shinji had a change of heart, he really is pure

i wonder if he chose to do it because he didnt want rei to pilot 01, or because he couldnt allow himself to step down. my moneys on the former

rei is willing to sacrifice herself to save shinji, theres some hidden trait that makes him special that we dont know about. she has it too, and shes probably aware, but shinji just has more of it

shinji asks why rei pilots her eva, she says its her "link". shinji says "to my father?", she says "to everyone", she wont elaborate further. she has nothing else. its the only way that she can make her life have meaning maybe? also the moon is lit up in this foresty green while shes saying this, which makes me think of the scene where shinjis friend tried to call him to apologize. 

wow. rei put up her life to give shinji that second shot and he actually landed it. i really hope shes okay


![[Pasted image 20260721132423.png]]

awwww :(((

this scene mirrors when shinjis dad saved rei, the only person we've seen her happy with. they officially have a connection!!!!

post episode:

that was a great episode. i think the shows gonna start showing some of its hand finally. theres a lot of imagery with rei and the moon, after the heartfelt scene at the end of this episode, the camera pans up to the moon. the outro is also the moon with rei seemingly floating next to it. thatll make more sense in the future im sure

**episode 7**

shinjis dad's office has the sigil from the intro on the ceiling? and his office is inside of a pyramid? some alien shit going on for sure

misato wears cross earrings

its also pissing me off how uncurious shinji is, i wouldnt be able to stop asking questions if i were in his position

ok nevermind right after i typed that he started asking questions

"evas are for peace on earth"
"the entry plug smells like blood"

the point of nerv is to prepare for the probable "third impact" the "second impact" was when a humanoid object hit antarctica, upon inspecting it it exploded. what was the first impact then? the meteor that killed the dinosaurs?

piloting an eva exposes you to "psychological contamination"?

of course theres politics in this situation ughh humans are so annoying
it does seem like nerv is a mostly altruistic organization as for now though

"thats the real misato, the one outsiders never see. that means you're family"

post episode

i can see the tension starting to build, i thought it was weird how cleanly that situation resolved. was that not a world ending threat? or at least japan ending threat?

misato seems to think it was a setup, like some weird demonstration. based on the conversation shinjis dad was having at  the start i wonder if nerv set it up somehow. "look at this other company, they cant possibly make good machines. give us all of the funding"


**episode 8**

![[Pasted image 20260722131025.png]]

i cant get over how much of this frame looks like gabriel from ultrakill, but im wondering if thats because gabriel has a certain imagery biblically, or if gabriel from ultrakill is just based off of evangelion

either way, putting wings like this on the eva makes me compare him to an angel, which is what the eva is designed to fight against right? i think this strengthens my "evas are angels turned weapons" theory even stronger. as im typing this, im also realizing that they referred to the first angel we saw in the show as the Third Angel, and that we are only aware of two evas. 00 and 01. are those the first two angels we've met then?

asuka!!! thats the red hair girls name! i knew it this whole time and just couldnt conjure it. shes probably the most famous character from this show right? im excited to meet her

asuka is the Second Children

Shinji is the Third Children

Rei is the First Children

Did i make up a fourth in my head? 

asuka seems jealous of shinjis natural talent

asuka says "a guy like him, picked to be the Third Children?" which implies that shinji was not divinely chosen, but rather multiple people can fill that role

wait so if im understanding correctly, misato's ex boyfriend is part of a plot with shinji's dad to orchestrate this attack? does nerv like secretly have the secret to controlling angels and they are demonstrating it secretly by staging these attacks to make it look like theyre the only ones who can possibly save the world?

i love asuka

Human Instrumentality Project
"Yes. This is the first human being."

this usage of "synchronization" and it being heightened and variable makes me wonder what exactly they are syncing with. the eva's soul? why is it more in sync when theres an uptick of emotion?

post episode:

the outro has a red tint to it now?? has the music changed key too? is this similar to the invincible title card where the more we unravel the mystery the more sinister the outro gets? what do they mean by the first human. have they recreated the biblical adam? or is it more of a euphemism for what they actually have. does this imply that the characters in the show are not human? or did they recover the fetus from the past and have it in present day. idfk man i have so many questions.

i love how this show is able to flip between like cutesy anime i love these characters to super serious wtf is going on so smoothly, i really like asuka and im glad shes a main addition to the cast.

**episode 9**

asuka is german, rei is reading a book in german. 

misato's ex is ryoji, just writing that down so i dont call him misato's bf anymore

angel 7 had yin/yang on it, another theme of spiritual connection/as above so below

ok i hate to break my shinji and rei ship but asuka might be perfect for him

i really really really really really really really hope they dont end up fighting over him :( why cant everyone get along :(

oh no :((( poor asuka i wonder what shes been through

and W shinji for not being a perv and moving out of the bed

post episode:

that was a nice episode :) it was cool to get to know asuka, i understand why shes so popular i really like her

the key of the outro song DEFINITELY changed, it might even be more red than last episode. 

not too many thoughts on this one, im rooting for shinji and asuka though

**episode 10**

shinji is feeling his first confliction between asuka and rei, he definitely feels guilty

theyre doing research so deep into the ground that its crushing a metal probe from pressure. i assume this is the suspected home of the angels? are they literally in hell?

i feel like theyve mentioned "blood types" a few times, may be important
this angel egg/fetus is "blue blood type"

i feel like theyve had rei benched for so long, she should get 03 if it exists

asuka seems to be insecure about rei, or just hates her. i wonder if thats because of shinji? or something else

"failure on nerv's part will spell the destruction of the world"

while asuka is descending, the entire show is red. literally everything deep red

misato is willing to put asuka in mortal danger for this angel specimen

"we wouldve had another second impact on our hands"?? why not a third impact? why not just another impact?

shinji put his life on the line for asuka

![[Pasted image 20260723135254.png]]

maybe im crazy but this truck makes me think of the split between asuka/shinji/rei, shinji in the middle as white with rei and asuka on either side of him. hes still undecided
![[Pasted image 20260723135351.png]]

the same colors immediately afterwards, but with red and blue interlinked and parallel, are rei and asuka linked in some way? is that why asuka dislikes her?

this is the second anime after frieren that ive seen make a big deal out of hot springs, do i need to go to one? it cant be that nice

misato has a fat scar on her chest from the second impact

asuka has a past that weighs on her, misato calls it "ancient history" and tells her not to let it bother her

post episode:

another chill episode, no new questions raised or big answers really. as much as i sound crazy i do think asuka and rei have some sort of past connection. i dont think we've really seen them interact on screen except for the first day asuka was at school. 

i was kinda weirded out by some of the sexualization of rei/asuka but i think the show is taking the chainsaw man route and using horniness as a story tool to explore the characters, im starting to tolerate it, im interested to see how shinji turns out

wtf the outro is back to blue again???? and back in the regular key?? what could that possibly mean

obviously there's rei vs asuka but rei is the one floating in both the red and blue outro, my first thought was that it maybe reflected who was more on shinji's mind but that doesnt make sense as this entire episode was basically built around shinjis relationship with asuka

ill just keep writing about it and hopefully we'll actually figure it out eventually

**episode 11**

The magi are super computers, like an ai maybe? they oversee the city. i think they were talked about in an earlier episode but i didnt write anything down

shinji's on the phone with his dad and the phone is green again. why are all phones green? maybe just art style

i just realized, asuka has red hair and blue eyes, while rei has blue hair and red eyes. complete inversions of one another. we also saw yin and yang on that angel earlier. im one piece of evidence away from going all in on them being the "same" in some sense

theres ANOTHER green phone in nerv, why the hell are all the phones green

![[Pasted image 20260723141933.png]]

deliberately putting the candle as the main focus of the shot so you can see the flame's red and blue part, red burns with fanfare and blue burns with more heat and less attention. remind you of anyone? why else would you deliberately animate a candle, not only with the blue bit of the flame, but with such detail

thank god shinji is finally asking questions omfg
"what do you think angels are?"

"angels, messengers of god. our enemies, bearing divine names. why are we fighting each other?"

asuka thinks the question is almost stupid, deliberate deflection? or no instinct to look closer at anything

"dont look down on me just because you get special treatment" -asuka
"i dont look down on you. plus, i dont get special treatment. i would know." -rei

"The First [REI] sure is scary. She's the sort who thinks the ends justify the means. A real holier-than-thou type." asuka to shinji about rei

yay we get to see all 3 evas in action finally

![[Pasted image 20260723143041.png]]

asukas eva is entirely red, reis eva is entirely blue, shinjis is purple with green tints. green like the phones, purple as in the combination of red and blue. mannnnn i have to know what the FUCK is going on this is all going to be so cool whenever i finally get answers

asuka is putting her life on the line for shinji/rei because shinji put his on the line for her. shows that she isnt fully selfish even if she can act like it

"Man fears the darkness, and so he scrapes away at the edges of it with fire" -Rei
WOW

post episode

outro is regular blue again, mood of this episode was pretty positive, maybe thats what it relates to. we got a victory so things are looking good. were the episodes where it was red darker/based around losing? let me check

ok so the first episode with red was when we met asuka, and the one after that was when we learned more about her

considering we know that asuka has some sort of past that haunts her, and that the red intro is much more malicious and is in a minor key, i wonder if it was some sort of foreshadowing for asuka being evil? she did brush off shinji's questioning of the angels really fast, what does she know that we dontttttt

**episode 12**

![[Pasted image 20260723144215.png]]

i just noticed that this shot in the intro is not rei on both sides of shinji but rather asuka and rei heading opposite directions of each other. more mirroring of the two. these two are linked. i fucking know it.

![[Pasted image 20260723144327.png]]

a figure in the same gray is immediately seen doing the as above so below gesture, right? we dont see the other hand, but i feel like that specific hand posture is only used to represent as above so below, disregarding the whole divine system shit that im not gonna bother deep diving into mid show cuz it feels a bit disingenuous. the way i see it is that translating things that are real spoken languages is fair game because someone who speaks t hat language will be watching the show, but no one natively speaks latin, so using it is meant to be a mystery.

this episode starts with a 15 years ago flashback, but then clarifies that its 2000 A.D. 
i think this does two things: one, shows that the concept of jesus/christianity exists in this universe. and two, implies that the show may show us things that are in the BC's

![[Pasted image 20260723144911.png]]

15 years ago was the Second Impact, it shows these wings which are incredibly similar to the ones we see on shinji's eva in the intro.  my theories are coming together omggggggggggg. the evas are tamed angels

misato's dad was killed in the Second Impact. shes also seen wearing a cross necklace, i think she wore the same style of cross/plus earrings earlier in the show, i just didnt write about it. it also looks like she was in the tube that they insert into the back of eva's to put the pilots in. was she an eva pilot? but if my theory of eva's being angels is true, how did she have one?

misato was promoted from captain to major

"she was bothered at how youre always so worried about what others think" misato to shinji about asuka

"why did you join nerv?" -shinji
"its been so long, i dont remember" -misato

im not gonna write exact quotes for this but, shinjis dad is at the south pole

they talk about how its land without life, and how humanity makes up for their weaknesses with science. he says science took things too far, and thats whatt caused the second impact. he also refers to antarctica as hell. he says antarctica is a pristine world, untainted by original sin.

an angel appeared out of nowhere in space? and it looks like a depiction of an eye? it sort of looks like a biblically accurate angel

misato wants revenge against the angels, presumably for killing her father

"miracles are only worth a damn when you make them happen yourself"

misato promises all 3 a steak dinner once this is over, thats never a good line to hear in anything fictional LOL

rei doesnt like meat

asuka pilots her eva for the status, rei does it because its all she has, shinji still isnt sure why he does

misato mirrors shinji in the sense that they are both working for nerv because of some weird issues with their father

shinjis dad praised shinji for the first time

"maybe i pilot my eva because i want my father to [praise me]"

**episode 13**

"Mother is as healthy as ever, while i get older with each passing day"
blonde lady who i think is the second highest at Nerv, i should really get her name down LMAO

does this mean her mom is dead? or that maybe her mom is the magi? is she some science experiment? is she an angel? thats just such a weird line idk

"time isnt the only thing that marches on, so does the eva's technology"
is this in reference to the eva's being self evolving? or to the scientists at nerv making better and better advances

The magi have names,

1 - melchior
2 - balthasar
3 - casper

are those ghost names? angel names? demon names? my bet is on demon, are they using divine technology for the magi? i mean its literally called "magic"

blonde lady name is ritsuko

ritsuko's mother built the magi, is her mother a demon?

are they testing remote operation of the evas?

the "imitation bodies" they are testing dont look robotic, they look fleshy. to me that sounds like the eva's are actual angels, and nerv is trying to copy their exact structure to be able to produce more evas

angel 11 has blue blood

angel 11 is "a literal computer", is this the magi trying to take over?

im so confused, did the magi use the info from the imitation bodies to create a real angel to take over the magi system? is this just a regular attack from the angels?

the magi were created by porting someones personality into a computer to allow it to actually think. its the same technology that powers the evas

ritsuko's mom's personality was transported into the magi

so many last second clutches in this show

it feels like this is heading towards a narrative about humanity being too curious and causing their own destruction

"the natural end of evolution is self destruction"
shinji's dad (who i will now call ikari) talks about the original sin, which was eve eating the apple of knowledge, or humans being curious. does humanity diving into science act as a real world version of biting the apple?

the magi are three parts of ritsukos mom, each being a different version of her

the scientist, the mother, and the woman

casper = woman (the woman in her held on to the bitter end)

post episode

it feels like this show just keeps opening and opening and opening itself up, we're almost halfway through the episodes and it feels like we still dont even have all of the questions we are supposed to have, let alone any answers.

ive reached the point where i cannot stop myself from watching, ive been watching 2-3 episodes a day for the last 4 days but today im probably gonna watch like 10 :sob:

again, i have my theories planted and im just waiting for more info to show up. 

**episode 14**

"the timeline is proceeding as set out in the dead sea scrolls"
i feel like thats such a huge line to drop out of nowhere with 0 fanfare

ikari claims the 11th angel never breached nerv hq, probably lying to not lose funding? or he set the entire thing up

"just remember that there is no need for you to write out a new scenario... everything will proceed according to Seele's plan"
????? thats such a loaded line i like cant even theorize its like just throwing the whole thing in my face wtf? lemme keep watching instead of typing lmao

monologue about the mountains (green), water (blue), and the sun (maybe red?)
nevermind, i think this is rei speaking. she speaks of the sky, the red red sky. also sunflowers/flowers which are bright yellow immediately after name dropping ikari for seemingly no reason

"the color red. i dont like red". -rei

"the smell of blood. a woman who does not bleed"
"human beings. made from red clay"
"human beings. made from man and woman}"

"evas. something created by man"
"what is man? something created by god?"
"man is something created by man?"

"all i have is my life. my heart"
"entry plug, the vessel of the heart. the seat of the soul"
"who is this? this is me. who am i? what am i?"
"i am myself. this object is myself. the shape that forms my self"
"this is the me that can be seen. but i sense that I am not me"
"i feel my body melting away, i no longer recognize myself"
"my form is fading away. i sense someone who is not me"
"is someone there? beyond here?"

im just gonna come back to all of this after the episode what the fuck
ive had this exact same breakdown that rei is seemingly having. its not a frantic manic anxiety breakdown. its just. separation of oneself from ones body. awareness of ones own awareness. so very strange.

she keeps questioning who dr ikari is? she cant put her finger on him like she can everyone else. did he create her?

"unit 02 isnt compatible with anyone else"
what makes asuka/02 special?

rei noted 01 smelling like shinji and shinji noted 00 smelling like rei. odd

![[Pasted image 20260723183137.png]]

thats actually fucking terrifying

are they trying to link rei and shinjis conscious?

"is this a repeat of that other time? is it trying to absorb shinji?"
this has happened before??

"could unit 00 have been trying to kill rei?"
maybe rei's soul is trapped in 00 and trying to kill the physical rei body?

"it was me that unit 00 was trying to hit. im sure of it." -ritsuko

when shinji wakes up in the hospital, the room is flooded with blue. has he merged with rei in some way?

"its this same stupid ceiling again"

"things would get complicated if seele got involved now"
"everything is proceeding according to *our* scenario. its not a concern"

the spear of longinus?
rei is carrying out the operation

post episode

wow

i have honestly no idea where to even start
that was such a loaded episode

i was literally tabbing out and quoting half the damn episode

so rei is having an existential realization. im curious to know more of her story. her and shinji are linked in some way. she hates the color red.
